info.title: Date Math
info.description: Deterministic date and time math for AI agents: date differences, business days, date arithmetic, time zone conversion and calendar facts. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, $0.001); probes and spec are free. All inputs are JSON bodies; all responses are JSON objects. Errors return {"error":{"code","message","example"}}.
info.x-guidance: Date Math does exact date and time arithmetic so you don't have to. Every tool is POST with a JSON body, returns a JSON object, and costs $0.001 (x402, USDC on Base). POST /v1/diff: days/weeks/months/business days between two dates (pass country, e.g. "US", to skip its public holidays). POST /v1/add: the date N days/weeks/months/business days before or after a date. POST /v1/convert: a time in another IANA time zone (DST-aware). POST /v1/info: weekday, ISO week, quarter or leap-year status of a date. POST /v1/holidays: a country's public holidays for a year. POST /v1/overlap: when working hours overlap across time zones (meeting slots). POST /v1/cron: explain a cron expression and list its next runs. POST /v1/parse: turn text like "next Friday at 3pm" into an exact datetime. POST /v1/city: the time zone and local time of a city by name. POST /v1/recurrence: concrete dates for an iCal RRULE ("every 2nd Tuesday"). POST /v1/business_hours: SLA deadline N working hours from now, or working hours elapsed. POST /v1/business_day: is a date a business day (and if not, which holiday), plus the next/previous business day. POST /v1/pay_dates: payroll or billing dates (monthly, 15th and last, biweekly, weekly) moved off weekends and holidays. Business-day tools accept workdays (e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; datetimes are ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; time zones are IANA names. Errors return HTTP 400 with {"error":{"code","message","example"}}; example is a valid body for that tool. Also available as an MCP server at /mcp.

from.description: First pay date returned is on or after this date

count.description: How many pay dates to return

days.description: monthly: 1 day, semi_monthly: 2 days of the month (1–31 or "last"; 31 clamps to month end). Defaults: ["last"] and [15, "last"]

anchor.description: weekly/biweekly: any one known pay date

adjust.description: Where to move a pay date that falls on a weekend or holiday

pay_date.description: The actual business day to pay

DateOrDateTime.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

Holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

DiffRequest.description: business_days counts working days (default Mon–Fri, see workdays) in [from, to) minus holidays; only for date inputs.

business_days.description: Applied after calendar units; skips rest days (see workdays) and holidays

AddRequest.description: Negative values subtract. Months clamp to month end (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Time units require a datetime input.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 with offset, local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS] (needs from_timezone), or "now" (default)

example.description: A valid request body for this tool, to correct the call

Country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

Workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat
